description: This file defines a client class for interacting with Amazon Route 53 Auto Naming (Service Discovery) via AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies method signatures for various operations related to namespace and service management within the Service Discovery service, inheriting from the AWSClient class.

classes.name: ServiceDiscoveryClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon Route 53 Auto Naming service, providing methods for namespace and service management.

methods.name: createHttpNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP namespace in Route 53 Auto Naming.

methods.name: createHttpNamespaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new HTTP namespace.

methods.name: createPrivateDnsNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new private DNS namespace.

methods.name: createPrivateDnsNamespaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new private DNS namespace.

methods.name: createPublicDnsNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new public DNS namespace.

methods.name: createPublicDnsNamespaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new public DNS namespace.

methods.name: createService
methods.description: Creates a new service within the service discovery namespace.

methods.name: deleteServiceAttributesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes attributes of a service.

methods.name: deregisterInstance
methods.description: Deregisters an instance from a service.

methods.name: discoverInstances
methods.description: Discovers instances associated with a namespace or service.

methods.name: discoverInstancesRevision
methods.description: Retrieves a specific revision of the discover instances operation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Gets details about a specific instance.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific namespace.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Gets details of a specific operation.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific service.

methods.name: listInstances
methods.description: Lists instances for a namespace or service.

methods.name: registerInstance
methods.description: Registers a new instance with a service.

methods.name: updateInstanceCustomHealthStatus
methods.description: Updates the health status of an instance.

methods.name: updatePrivateDnsNamespaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a private DNS namespace.

methods.name: updatePublicDnsNamespaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a public DNS namespace.
